harnessDoctorNotes: npx harness doctor --json ran in the target clone and reported the installed CLI plus extension loader, but its source-checkout cli-build layer was degraded because harness/cli/dist/index.js is not present inside the consumer repo.
summary: Installed the local harness core into the fresh Chalk clone, produced a B/B harnessability assessment, continued past the abandonment gate, wrote the BIO governance document, authored and independently verified a boot extension around npm test, and recorded the retro via harness record retro. The flow passed, with notable project friction around the missing harness init writer and consumer-mode doctor degradation.

retrospective.workedWell: The target repo had a compact, verified npm test lane and no remote-service pressure, so assessment, governance, and boot could all be grounded in deterministic local evidence.
retrospective.confusing: The shell MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT pointed at the run folder rather than the harness source root, harness doctor reported a source-build degradation in a consumer clone, and harness new had no description flag even though the generated summary needed editing.
retrospective.magicWand: Ship `harness init` so it can read `.harness/reports/harnessability/latest.json` and generate `.harness/engineering-harness.md` with the eight BIO fields instead of requiring hand-written governance during setup-flow dogfood runs.

coordination.notes: No peer coordination was used in this single-shot run.

difficulties.description: The task said to start with `cd $MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT`, but the shell variable pointed at the run folder where skills were disabled; the actual harness source root was only available from runtime context.
difficulties.workaround: Ran `minih skills doctor` from `~/substrate/harness-engineering` and used that path for the local harness install.
difficulties.mitigation: Expose separate unambiguous variables such as MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT and MINIH_RUN_ROOT, or make the prompt match the variable value.

difficulties.description: `npx harness doctor --json` in the consumer clone reported `cli-build` degraded because it checked for `harness/cli/dist/index.js` in the target repo even though the installed npx harness binary was usable.
difficulties.workaround: Treated harnessInstalled as true because doctor ran and reported, then independently checked extension loading, help output, and boot execution.
difficulties.mitigation: Teach doctor to distinguish source-checkout mode from installed-consumer mode.

difficulties.description: The local harness install added a file dependency to Chalk's package.json, which is acceptable in the throwaway clone but noisy for assessing the original repo state.
difficulties.workaround: Read `git show HEAD:package.json` for original repo evidence and kept all writes inside the target clone.
difficulties.mitigation: Document the mutation explicitly in the flow recipe or provide a no-save install path for local dogfood installs.

difficulties.description: A broad file glob after npm install traversed node_modules and timed out, producing dependency noise during assessment.
difficulties.workaround: Switched to targeted file reads and a pruned file listing that excluded node_modules and .git.
difficulties.mitigation: Add a prompt note or helper pattern to exclude dependency directories after the required install step.

difficulties.description: `harness new boot --wrap "npm test" --description ...` failed because the scaffold command has no description option, and the generated extension initially contained a TODO summary.
difficulties.workaround: Retried with the documented `--wrap` form, then edited the scaffolded summary and returned evidence paths.
difficulties.mitigation: Add a `--summary` or `--description` flag to `harness new`, or document that generated summaries must be filled after scaffolding.

difficulties.description: Governance had to be hand-written from the BIO template because there is no shipped `harness init` writer.
difficulties.workaround: Used the governance reference template and grounded all eight fields in the assessment and verified npm test lane.
difficulties.mitigation: Implement `harness init` to generate the governance document from assessment facts and repo command evidence.
